title: Lessons store + sutra_remember + sutra_read injection
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to build

The foundational slice: shared sqlite DB at `~/.sutra/lessons.db`, the `LessonsDb` struct with its own migration system, the `sutra_remember` MCP tool (write path), and lesson injection into `sutra_read` responses (read path). At the end of this slice, an agent can write a lesson anchored to a symbol and see it surface when reading that symbol.

Schema: `lessons` table (id, text, created_by, created_at, project_origin, verified, confidence, last_surfaced, last_cited, archived), `anchors` table (lesson_id, kind, value), `categories` table (lesson_id, tag), `citations` table (lesson_id, task_id, field, timestamp).

Write path: `sutra_remember(text, location_anchors, source_tasks?)` stores a lesson with explicit anchors. No enrichment yet — that comes in a later slice.

Read path: `sutra_read` builds a `MatchContext` from the resolved symbol name, queries `LessonsDb::query_for_context()` with exact symbol anchor match, and includes matching lessons in the response JSON.

`SutraServer` gains a `lessons_db: Arc<LessonsDb>` field, opened once at startup.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `~/.sutra/lessons.db` created on first server startup with correct schema
- [ ] `sutra_remember` tool registered and callable — stores a lesson with text + location anchors
- [ ] `sutra_read` for a symbol with a matching lesson includes the lesson in the response
- [ ] `sutra_read` for a symbol with no matching lesson returns the normal response (no regression)
- [ ] LessonsDb has its own migration system independent of per-workspace index.db
- [ ] WAL mode enabled on the shared DB
- [ ] Tests: store/retrieve round-trips, symbol anchor matching, no-match returns empty

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately
